figurative_meaning_en: To be content or happy at heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার পরিবারের সাথে ভালো থাকা।
আমি এখন ভালো থাকছি, চিন্তা করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is staying well with his family.
I'm doing well now, don't worry.
note: Common greeting phrase in Bengali culture, often used in farewells like 'ভালো থেকো' meaning 'stay well'.
